blocks.text: (13) Shri Chintamani Panigurehi relinquished the office of Minister of State in the Ministry of Home Affairs and assumed the office of Minister of State in the Department of Defence Production & Supplies in the Ministry of Defence.
(14) Shri Giridhar Gomango relinquished the office of Minister of State in the Ministry of Tourism and assumed the office of Minister of State in the Ministry of Communications.
(15) Shri Santosh Mohan Dev relinquished the office or Minister of state in the Ministry of Defence and assumed the office of Minister of State in the Ministry of Home Affairs.

(16) Shri S. Krisna Kumar relinquished the office of Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting and assumed the office of Minister of State in the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
(17) Smt. Shela Dikshit, Minister of State in the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs also assumed the office of the Minister of State in the Prime Minister's Office.
(18) Shri Refique Alam relinquished the office of the Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas and assumed the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of Textiles.
(19) Shri P. Namgyal, Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Surface Transport also assumed the office of the Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs.
(20) Shri Radhekrishnan Melaviy, Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Labour also assumed the office of Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs.
(21) Shri S.B. Chavan assumed the office of Minister of Finance.
(22) Shri B. Shankaranand assumed the office of Minister of Law and Justice and also assumed the additional charge of the office of the Minister of Water Resources.
(23) Shri Madhaveinh Solankii assumed the office of Minister of Planning and also assumed the additional charge of office of the Minister of Programme Implementation.
(24) Shri Vir Bahadur Singh assumed the office of the Minister of Communications.
(25) Shri Kelp Nath Rej assumed the office of the Minister of State in the Department of Power in the Ministry of Energy.
